mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tour.organizers WHERE email = #{email}) AS email_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tour.organizers WHERE username = BTRIM(#{username})) AS username_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tour.organizers WHERE name = BTRIM(#{name})) AS name_exists
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tour.organizers ( images_id, name, email, username, description, contact_no, slogan, verification, social_link ) VALUES ( #{imagesId}, BTRIM(#{name}), #{email}, BTRIM(#{username}), #{description}, #{contactNo}, #{slogan}, CAST(#{verification} AS level_type), #{socialLink} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tour.organizers SET images_id = #{imagesId}, name = BTRIM(#{name}), email = #{email}, username = BTRIM(#{username}), description = #{description}, contact_no = #{contactNo}, slogan = #{slogan}, verification = CAST(#{verification} AS level_type), social_link = #{socialLink} WHERE id = #{organizersId}
mapper.select:
SELECT o.* FROM tour.organizers o
AND LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{name}) || '%'
AND LOWER(o.email) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{email}) || '%'
ORDER BY o.id DESC
